description: Every dated event of one act, past and future, each classified: entry_into_force and application (kept apart, with their scope: the whole act, a staged tranche or a set of provisions), deadline (an obligation due date inside the act, never a state of any provision), transposition_deadline (directives; the subject is member_states), new_version (a change in the words, with the consolidated version), end_of_validity, and proposal (labelled proposed, never law). Each event states its date, kind, axis, subject and reach, scope, source, whether its date is held, and when it falls relative to as_at. The act's position (status and whom it is about) on as_at comes with it, with the coverage of what we hold. Answers "what is the full dated history and future of this act".

as_at.description: The day to read the position on, YYYY-MM-DD. Left out, it is the act's legal day today (Brussels for EU law, London for UK law). It is always echoed back.

celex_id.description: The act: a CELEX ID, Lex-Ray ID or nickname (e.g., '32024R1689', 'ai act').

include_proposals.description: Include in-flight proposals to amend the act, labelled proposed.

since.description: Only events on or after this date.

until.description: Only events on or before this date.

name: get_timeline
